name: todo-app
context: Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript + Drizzle/Postgres. Use src/ layout. API routes return JSON {data|error}. UI uses Tailwind + shadcn/ui components from src/components/ui.

tasks.title: DB schema and shared types
tasks.prompt: Create the Drizzle schema for users and todos (id, userId, title, done, createdAt), a db client in src/db/index.ts, and shared TS types in src/types. Add needed deps to package.json. Done when `npx tsc --noEmit` passes.

tasks.title: Email/password auth
tasks.prompt: Implement session-based email/password auth (argon2 hashing, httpOnly secure cookies, CSRF-safe POST handlers), login/register pages, and middleware protecting /app/*. Done when typecheck passes and you've described the threat model in notes.

tasks.title: Todo CRUD API
tasks.prompt: REST handlers for todos (list/create/update/delete) scoped to the current user via getSession() from src/auth (assume it exists: returns {userId}|null). Validate input with zod. Done when typecheck passes.

tasks.title: README
tasks.prompt: Write a concise README: setup, env vars (DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET), scripts.
